payload.source_text: Examples
payload.target_text: Contoh

payload.source_text: The goal for the remainder of this section is to give some classical examples of martingales, and by doing so, to show the wide variety of applications in which martingales occur. We will return to many of these examples in subsequent sections. Without further ado, we assume that all random variables are real-valued, unless otherwise specified, and that all expected values mentioned below exist in \( \R \). Be sure to try the proofs yourself before expanding the details.
payload.target_text: Tujuan bagian selanjutnya adalah memberikan beberapa contoh klasik martingal dan, melalui contoh-contoh itu, menunjukkan beragam penerapan tempat martingal muncul. Kita akan kembali membahas banyak contoh ini dalam bagian-bagian berikutnya. Tanpa pengantar lebih lanjut, kita mengandaikan bahwa semua peubah acak bernilai riil, kecuali dinyatakan lain, dan bahwa semua nilai harapan yang disebutkan di bawah ada di \( \R \). Pastikan Anda mencoba sendiri pembuktiannya sebelum membuka rincian.

payload.source_text: Constant Sequence
payload.target_text: Barisan Konstan

payload.source_text: Our first example is rather trivial, but still worth noting.
payload.target_text: Contoh pertama kita cukup sederhana, tetapi tetap layak diperhatikan.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \) is a filtration on the probability space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \) and that \( X \) is a random variable that is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_0 \) and satisfies \( \E(\left|X\right|) \lt \infty \). Let \( X_t = X \) for \( t \in T \). Them \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak{F} \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \) adalah filtrasi pada ruang probabilitas \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \), dan \( X \) adalah peubah acak yang terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_0 \) serta memenuhi \( \E(\left|X\right|) \lt \infty \). Tetapkan \( X_t = X \) untuk \( t \in T \). Maka \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak{F} \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text: Since \( X \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_0 \), it is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_t \) for all \( t \in T \). Hence \( \bs{X} \) is adapted to \( \mathfrak{F} \). If \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \), then \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = \E(X \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = X = X_s \).
payload.target_text: Karena \( X \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_0 \), peubah tersebut terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_t \) untuk semua \( t \in T \). Karena itu, \( \bs{X} \) teradaptasi terhadap \( \mathfrak{F} \). Jika \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \), maka \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = \E(X \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = X = X_s \).

payload.source_text: Partial Sums
payload.target_text: Jumlah Parsial

payload.source_text:
For our next discussion, we start with one of the most basic martingales in discrete time, and the one with the simplest interpretation in terms of gambling. Suppose that \( \bs{V} = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) is a sequence of independent random variables with \( \E(|V_k|) \lt \infty \) for \( k \in \N \). Let
\[ X_n = \sum_{k=0}^n V_k, \quad n \in \N \]
payload.target_text:
Untuk pembahasan berikutnya, kita mulai dengan salah satu martingal paling dasar dalam waktu diskret, yang juga memiliki interpretasi perjudian paling sederhana. Misalkan \( \bs{V} = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) adalah barisan peubah acak independen dengan \( \E(|V_k|) \lt \infty \) untuk \( k \in \N \). Tetapkan
\[ X_n = \sum_{k=0}^n V_k, \quad n \in \N \]

payload.source_text: For the partial sum process \( \bs X \),
payload.target_text: Untuk proses jumlah parsial \( \bs X \),

payload.source_text: If \( \E(V_n) \ge 0 \) for \( n \in \N_+ \) then \( \bs X \) is a sub-martingale.
payload.target_text: Jika \( \E(V_n) \ge 0 \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \), maka \( \bs X \) merupakan submartingal.

payload.source_text: If \( \E(V_n) \le 0 \) for \( n \in \N_+ \) then \( \bs X \) is a super-martingale.
payload.target_text: Jika \( \E(V_n) \le 0 \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \), maka \( \bs X \) merupakan supermartingal.

payload.source_text: If \( \E(V_n) = 0 \) for \( n \in \N_+ \) then \( \bs X \) is a martingale.
payload.target_text: Jika \( \E(V_n) = 0 \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \), maka \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal.

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
Let \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_n\} = \sigma\{V_0, V_1, \ldots, V_n\}\) for \( n \in \N \) . Note first that
		\[ \E(|X_n|) \le \sum_{k=0}^n \E(|V_k|) \lt \infty, \quad n \in \N \]
		Next,
		\[ \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left(X_n + V_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left(X_n \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) + \E\left(V_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = X_n + \E(V_{n+1}), \quad n \in \N \]
		The last equality holds since \( X_n \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_n \) and \( V_{n+1} \) is independent of \( \mathscr{F}_n \). The results now follow from the definitions.
payload.target_text:
Tetapkan \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_n\} = \sigma\{V_0, V_1, \ldots, V_n\}\) untuk \( n \in \N \) . Pertama, perhatikan bahwa
		\[ \E(|X_n|) \le \sum_{k=0}^n \E(|V_k|) \lt \infty, \quad n \in \N \]
		Selanjutnya,
		\[ \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left(X_n + V_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left(X_n \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) + \E\left(V_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = X_n + \E(V_{n+1}), \quad n \in \N \]
		Kesamaan terakhir berlaku karena \( X_n \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_n \) dan \( V_{n+1} \) independen dari \( \mathscr{F}_n \). Hasil-hasil tersebut sekarang mengikuti definisi.

payload.source_text: In terms of gambling, if \( X_0 = V_0 \) is the gambler's initial fortune and \( V_i \) is the gambler's net winnings on the \( i \)th game, then \( X_n \) is the gamblers net fortune after \( n \) games for \( n \in \N_+ \). But partial sum processes associated with independent sequences are important far beyond gambling. In fact, much of classical probability deals with partial sums of independent and identically distributed variables. The entire chapter on Random Samples explores this setting.
payload.target_text: Dalam konteks perjudian, jika \( X_0 = V_0 \) adalah kekayaan awal penjudi dan \( V_i \) adalah kemenangan bersih penjudi pada permainan ke-\( i \), maka \( X_n \) adalah kekayaan bersih penjudi setelah \( n \) permainan untuk \( n \in \N_+ \). Namun, proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan barisan independen penting jauh melampaui perjudian. Bahkan, sebagian besar probabilitas klasik membahas jumlah parsial peubah-peubah independen dan berdistribusi identik . Seluruh bab tentang Sampel Acak mengkaji kerangka ini.

payload.source_text: Note that \( \E(X_n) = \sum_{k=0}^n \E(V_k) \). Hence condition (a) is equivalent to \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) increasing, condition (b) is equivalent to \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) decreasing, and condition (c) is equivalent to \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) constant. Here is another martingale associated with the partial sum process, known as the second moment martingale .
payload.target_text: Perhatikan bahwa \( \E(X_n) = \sum_{k=0}^n \E(V_k) \). Karena itu, syarat (a) ekuivalen dengan \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) menaik, syarat (b) ekuivalen dengan \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) menurun, dan syarat (c) ekuivalen dengan \( n \mapsto \E(X_n) \) konstan. Berikut martingal lain yang terkait dengan proses jumlah parsial, yang dikenal sebagai martingal momen kedua .

payload.source_text:
Suppose that \( \E(V_k) = 0 \) for \( k \in \N_+ \) and \( \var(V_k) \lt \infty \) for \( k \in \N \). Let 
	\[Y_n = X_n^2 - \var(X_n), \quad n \in \N \]
	Then \( \bs Y = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \bs X \).
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( \E(V_k) = 0 \) untuk \( k \in \N_+ \) dan \( \var(V_k) \lt \infty \) untuk \( k \in \N \). Tetapkan 
	\[Y_n = X_n^2 - \var(X_n), \quad n \in \N \]
	Maka \( \bs Y = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \bs X \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
Again, let \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_n\} \) for \( n \in \N \). Since the sequence \( \bs V \) is independent, note that 
		\[ \var(X_n) = \var\left(\sum_{k=0}^n V_k\right) = \sum_{k=0}^n \var(V_k)\] 
		Also, \( \var(V_k) = \E(V_k^2) \) since \( \E(V_k) = 0 \) for \( k \in \N_+ \). In particular, \( \E(|Y_n|) \lt \infty \) for \( n \in \N \). Next for \( n \in \N \),
		\begin{align*}
			\E(Y_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) &= \E\left[X_{n+1}^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] = \E\left[(X_n + V_{n+1})^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] \\
			&= \E\left[X_n^2 + 2 X_n V_{n+1} + V_{n+1}^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] = X_n^2 + 2 X_n \E(V_{n+1}) + \E(V_{n+1}^2) - \var(X_{n+1})
		\end{align*}
		since \( X_n \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_n \) and \( V_{n+1} \) is independent of \( \mathscr{F}_n \). But \( \E(V_{n+1}) = 0 \) and \( E(V_{n+1}^2) - \var(X_{n+1}) = - \var(X_n) \). Hence we have \( \E(Y_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = X_n^2 - \var(X_n) = Y_n \) for \( n \in \N \).
payload.target_text:
Sekali lagi, tetapkan \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_n\} \) untuk \( n \in \N \). Karena barisan \( \bs V \) independen, perhatikan bahwa 
		\[ \var(X_n) = \var\left(\sum_{k=0}^n V_k\right) = \sum_{k=0}^n \var(V_k)\] 
		Selain itu, \( \var(V_k) = \E(V_k^2) \) karena \( \E(V_k) = 0 \) untuk \( k \in \N_+ \). Secara khusus, \( \E(|Y_n|) \lt \infty \) untuk \( n \in \N \). Selanjutnya, untuk \( n \in \N \),
		\begin{align*}
			\E(Y_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) &= \E\left[X_{n+1}^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] = \E\left[(X_n + V_{n+1})^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] \\
			&= \E\left[X_n^2 + 2 X_n V_{n+1} + V_{n+1}^2 - \var(X_{n+1}) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right] = X_n^2 + 2 X_n \E(V_{n+1}) + \E(V_{n+1}^2) - \var(X_{n+1})
		\end{align*}
		karena \( X_n \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_n \) dan \( V_{n+1} \) independen dari \( \mathscr{F}_n \). Namun, \( \E(V_{n+1}) = 0 \) dan \( E(V_{n+1}^2) - \var(X_{n+1}) = - \var(X_n) \). Dengan demikian, kita memperoleh \( \E(Y_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = X_n^2 - \var(X_n) = Y_n \) untuk \( n \in \N \).

payload.source_text: So under the assumptions in this theorem, both \( \bs X \) and \( \bs Y \) are martingales. We will generalize the results for partial sum processes below in the discussion on processes with independent increments in .

payload.source_text: Martingale Difference Sequences
payload.target_text: Barisan Selisih Martingal

payload.source_text: In the last discussion, we saw that the partial sum process associated with a sequence of independent, mean 0 variables is a martingale. Conversely, every martingale in discrete time can be written as a partial sum process of uncorrelated mean 0 variables. This representation gives some significant insight into the theory of martingales generally. Suppose that \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) is a martingale with respect to the filtration \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \).
payload.target_text: Dalam pembahasan sebelumnya, kita melihat bahwa proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan barisan peubah independen dengan rata-rata 0 merupakan martingal. Sebaliknya, setiap martingal dalam waktu diskret dapat ditulis sebagai proses jumlah parsial dari peubah-peubah tak berkorelasi dengan rata-rata 0. Representasi ini memberikan pemahaman penting tentang teori martingal secara umum. Misalkan \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap filtrasi \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \).

payload.source_text:
Let \( V_0 = X_0 \) and \( V_n = X_n - X_{n-1} \) for \( n \in \N_+ \). The process \( \bs V = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) is the martingale difference sequence associated with \( \bs X \) and 
	\[ X_n = \sum_{k=0}^n V_k, \quad n \in \N \]
payload.target_text:
Tetapkan \( V_0 = X_0 \) dan \( V_n = X_n - X_{n-1} \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \). Proses \( \bs V = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan barisan selisih martingal yang terkait dengan \( \bs X \), dan 
	\[ X_n = \sum_{k=0}^n V_k, \quad n \in \N \]

payload.source_text: As promised, the martingale difference variables have mean 0, and in fact satisfy a stronger property.

payload.source_text: We now know that a discrete-time martingale is the partial sum process associated with a sequence of uncorrelated variables. Hence we might hope that there are martingale versions of the fundamental theorems that hold for a partial sum process associated with an independent sequence. This turns out to be true, and is a basic reason for the importance of martingales.
payload.target_text: Sekarang kita mengetahui bahwa martingal waktu diskret merupakan proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan barisan peubah tak berkorelasi. Karena itu, kita dapat berharap bahwa teorema-teorema dasar untuk proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan barisan independen memiliki versi martingal. Ternyata memang demikian, dan inilah salah satu alasan mendasar pentingnya martingal.

payload.source_text: Discrete-Time Random Walks
payload.target_text: Gerak Acak Waktu Diskret

payload.source_text:
Suppose that \( \bs V = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) is a sequence of independent random variables with \( \{V_n: n \in \N_+\} \) identically distributed. We assume that \( \E(|V_n|) \lt \infty \) for \( n \in \N \) and we let \( a \) denote the common mean of \( \{V_n: n \in \N_+\} \). Let \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) be the partial sum process associated with \( \bs V \) so that
\[ X_n = \sum_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
This setting is a special case of the more general partial sum process considered in . The process \( \bs X \) is sometimes called a (discrete-time) random walk . The initial position \( X_0 = V_0 \) of the walker can have an arbitrary distribution, but then the steps that the walker takes are independent and identically distributed. In terms of gambling, \( X_0 = V_0 \) is the initial fortune of the gambler playing a sequence of independent and identical games. If \( V_i \) is the amount won (or lost) on game \( i \in \N_+ \), then \( X_n \) is the gambler's net fortune after \( n \) games.
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( \bs V = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) adalah barisan peubah acak independen dengan \( \{V_n: n \in \N_+\} \) berdistribusi identik. Kita mengandaikan bahwa \( \E(|V_n|) \lt \infty \) untuk \( n \in \N \), dan \( a \) menyatakan rata-rata yang sama dari \( \{V_n: n \in \N_+\} \). Misalkan \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) adalah proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan \( \bs V \), sehingga
\[ X_n = \sum_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Kerangka ini merupakan kasus khusus dari proses jumlah parsial yang lebih umum pada . Proses \( \bs X \) kadang-kadang disebut gerak acak (waktu diskret). Posisi awal \( X_0 = V_0 \) dari pejalan dapat memiliki distribusi sembarang, sedangkan langkah-langkah berikutnya saling independen dan berdistribusi identik. Dalam konteks perjudian, \( X_0 = V_0 \) adalah kekayaan awal penjudi yang memainkan serangkaian permainan independen dan identik. Jika \( V_i \) adalah jumlah yang dimenangkan (atau hilang) pada permainan \( i \in \N_+ \), maka \( X_n \) adalah kekayaan bersih penjudi setelah \( n \) permainan.

Our next discussion is similar to the one on partial sum processes in , but with products instead of sums. So suppose that \( \bs V = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) is an independent sequence of nonnegative random variables with \( \E(V_n) \lt \infty \) for \( n \in \N \). Let
\[ X_n = \prod_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
so that \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) is the partial product process associated with \( \bs X \).

\[ X_n = \prod_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
sehingga \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan proses hasil kali parsial yang terkait dengan \( \bs X \).

payload.source_text: The Simple Random Walk
payload.target_text: Gerak Acak Sederhana

payload.source_text:
Suppose now that that \( \bs{V} = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) is a sequence of independent random variables with \( \P(V_i = 1) = p \) and \( \P(V_i = -1) = 1 - p \) for \( i \in \N_+ \), where \( p \in (0, 1) \). Let \( \bs{X}  = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) be the partial sum process associated with \( \bs{V} \) so that
\[ X_n = \sum_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Then \( \bs{X} \) is the simple random walk with parameter \( p \), and of course, is a special case of the more general random walk studied in . In terms of gambling, our gambler plays a sequence of independent and identical games, and on each game, wins €1 with probability \( p \) and loses €1 with probability \( 1 - p \). So if \( V_0 \) is the gambler's initial fortune, then \( X_n \) is her net fortune after \( n \) games.
payload.target_text:
Sekarang misalkan \( \bs{V} = \{V_n: n \in \N\} \) adalah barisan peubah acak independen dengan \( \P(V_i = 1) = p \) dan \( \P(V_i = -1) = 1 - p \) untuk \( i \in \N_+ \), dengan \( p \in (0, 1) \). Misalkan \( \bs{X}  = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) adalah proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan \( \bs{V} \), sehingga
\[ X_n = \sum_{i=0}^n V_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Maka \( \bs{X} \) merupakan gerak acak sederhana dengan parameter \( p \), dan tentu saja merupakan kasus khusus dari gerak acak yang lebih umum pada . Dalam konteks perjudian, penjudi kita memainkan serangkaian permainan independen dan identik. Pada setiap permainan, ia memenangkan €1 dengan probabilitas \( p \) dan kehilangan €1 dengan probabilitas \( 1 - p \). Jadi, jika \( V_0 \) adalah kekayaan awal penjudi, maka \( X_n \) adalah kekayaan bersihnya setelah \( n \) permainan.

payload.source_text: The Beta-Bernoulli Process
payload.target_text: Proses Beta-Bernoulli

payload.source_text:
Recall that the beta-Bernoulli process is constructed by randomizing the success parameter in a Bernoulli trials process with a beta distribution . Specifically we have a random variable \( P \) that has the beta distribution  with parameters \( a, \, b \in (0, \infty) \), and a sequence of indicator variables \( \bs X = (X_1, X_2, \ldots) \) such that given \( P = p \in (0, 1) \), \( \bs X \) is a sequence of independent variables with \( \P(X_i = 1) = p \) for \( i \in \N_+ \). As usual, we couch this in reliability terms, so that \( X_i = 1 \) means success on trial \( i \) and \( X_i = 0 \) means failure . In our study of this process, we showed that the finite-dimensional distributions are given by
\[ \P(X_1 = x_1, X_2 = x_2, \ldots, X_n = x_n) = \frac{a^{[k]} b^{[n-k]}}{(a + b)^{[n]}}, \quad n \in \N_+, \; (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \in \{0, 1\}^n \]
where we use the ascending power notation \( r^{[j]} = r ( r + 1) \cdots (r + j - 1) \) for \( r \in \R \) and \( j \in \N \). Next, let \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) denote the partial sum process associated with \( \bs{X} \), so that once again,
\[ Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Of course \( Y_n \) is the number of success in the first \( n \) trials and has the beta-binomial distribution defined by
\[ \P(Y_n = k) = \binom{n}{k} \frac{a^{[k]} b^{[n-k]}}{(a + b)^{[n]}}, \quad k \in \{0, 1, \ldots, n\} \]
Now let
\[ Z_n = \frac{a + Y_n}{a + b + n}, \quad n \in \N\]
This variable also arises naturally. Let \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\}\) for \( n \in \N \). Then as shown in the section on the beta-Bernoulli process, \( Z_n = \E(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = \E(P \mid \mathscr{F}_n) \). In statistical terms, the second equation means that \( Z_n \) is the Bayesian estimator of the unknown success probability \( p \) in a sequence of Bernoulli trials, when \( p \) is modeled by the random variable \( P \).
payload.target_text:
Ingat bahwa proses beta-Bernoulli dikonstruksi dengan mengacak parameter keberhasilan dalam suatu proses percobaan Bernoulli menggunakan distribusi beta . Secara khusus, kita memiliki peubah acak \( P \) yang berdistribusi beta dengan parameter \( a, \, b \in (0, \infty) \), serta barisan peubah indikator \( \bs X = (X_1, X_2, \ldots) \) sedemikian sehingga, dengan syarat \( P = p \in (0, 1) \), \( \bs X \) merupakan barisan peubah independen dengan \( \P(X_i = 1) = p \) untuk \( i \in \N_+ \). Seperti biasa, kita menyatakannya dalam istilah keandalan, sehingga \( X_i = 1 \) berarti berhasil pada percobaan \( i \), sedangkan \( X_i = 0 \) berarti gagal . Dalam kajian kita atas proses ini, kita menunjukkan bahwa distribusi berdimensi hingga diberikan oleh
\[ \P(X_1 = x_1, X_2 = x_2, \ldots, X_n = x_n) = \frac{a^{[k]} b^{[n-k]}}{(a + b)^{[n]}}, \quad n \in \N_+, \; (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \in \{0, 1\}^n \]
di mana kita menggunakan notasi pangkat naik \( r^{[j]} = r ( r + 1) \cdots (r + j - 1) \) untuk \( r \in \R \) dan \( j \in \N \). Selanjutnya, misalkan \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) menyatakan proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan \( \bs{X} \), sehingga sekali lagi,
\[ Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Tentu saja \( Y_n \) adalah banyaknya keberhasilan dalam \( n \) percobaan pertama dan memiliki distribusi beta-binomial yang didefinisikan oleh
\[ \P(Y_n = k) = \binom{n}{k} \frac{a^{[k]} b^{[n-k]}}{(a + b)^{[n]}}, \quad k \in \{0, 1, \ldots, n\} \]
Sekarang tetapkan
\[ Z_n = \frac{a + Y_n}{a + b + n}, \quad n \in \N\]
Peubah ini juga muncul secara alami. Tetapkan \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\}\) untuk \( n \in \N \). Seperti ditunjukkan dalam bagian tentang proses beta-Bernoulli, \( Z_n = \E(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = \E(P \mid \mathscr{F}_n) \). Dalam istilah statistika, persamaan kedua berarti bahwa \( Z_n \) merupakan penduga Bayes bagi probabilitas keberhasilan \( p \) yang tidak diketahui dalam barisan percobaan Bernoulli, ketika \( p \) dimodelkan oleh peubah acak \( P \).

payload.source_text: \( \bs Z = \{Z_n: n \in \N\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \bs X \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs Z = \{Z_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \bs X \).

payload.source_text:
Note that \( 0 \le Z_n \le 1 \) so \( \E(Z_n) \lt \infty \) for \( n \in \N \). Next,
		\[\E\left(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left[\frac{a + Y_{n+1}}{a + b + n + 1} \biggm| \mathscr{F}_n\right] = \frac{\E\left[a + \left(Y_n + X_{n+1}\right) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right]}{a + b + n + 1} = \frac{a + Y_n + \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right)}{a + b + n + 1} \]
		As noted above, \( \E(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = (a + Y_n) / (a + b + n) \). Substituting into the displayed equation above and doing a bit of algebra we have
		\[ \E(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = \frac{(a + Y_n) + (a + Y_n) / (a + b + n)}{a + b + n + 1} = \frac{a + Y_n}{a + b + n} = Z_n \]
payload.target_text:

payload.source_text: Pólya's Urn Process
payload.target_text: Proses Urna Pólya

payload.source_text:
Recall that in the simplest version of Pólya's urn process , we start with an urn containing \( a \) red and \( b \) green balls. At each discrete time step, we select a ball at random from the urn and then replace the ball and add \( c \) new balls of the same color to the urn. For the parameters, we need \( a, \, b \in \N_+ \) and \( c \in \N \). For \( i \in \N_+ \), let \( X_i \) denote the color of the ball selected on the \( i \)th draw, where 1 means red and 0 means green. The process \( \bs{X} = \{X_n: n \in \N_+\} \) is a classical example of a sequence of exchangeable yet dependent variables. Let \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) denote the partial sum process associated with \( \bs{X} \), so that once again,
\[ Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Of course \( Y_n \) is the total number of red balls selected in the first \( n \) draws. Hence at time \( n \in \N \), the total number of red balls in the urn is \( a + c Y_n \), while the total number of balls in the urn is \( a + b + c n \) and so the proportion of red balls in the urn is
\[ Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} \]
payload.target_text:
Ingat bahwa dalam versi paling sederhana dari proses urna Pólya , kita mulai dengan sebuah urna yang berisi \( a \) bola merah dan \( b \) bola hijau. Pada setiap langkah waktu diskret, kita memilih sebuah bola secara acak dari urna, lalu mengembalikan bola tersebut dan menambahkan \( c \) bola baru dengan warna yang sama ke dalam urna. Parameternya harus memenuhi \( a, \, b \in \N_+ \) dan \( c \in \N \). Untuk \( i \in \N_+ \), misalkan \( X_i \) menyatakan warna bola yang terpilih pada pengambilan ke-\( i \), dengan 1 berarti merah dan 0 berarti hijau. Proses \( \bs{X} = \{X_n: n \in \N_+\} \) merupakan contoh klasik barisan peubah yang dapat dipertukarkan tetapi saling bergantung. Misalkan \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_n: n \in \N\} \) menyatakan proses jumlah parsial yang terkait dengan \( \bs{X} \), sehingga sekali lagi,
\[ Y_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i, \quad n \in \N \]
Tentu saja \( Y_n \) adalah jumlah bola merah yang terpilih dalam \( n \) pengambilan pertama. Karena itu, pada waktu \( n \in \N \), jumlah bola merah dalam urna adalah \( a + c Y_n \), sedangkan jumlah seluruh bola dalam urna adalah \( a + b + c n \). Jadi, proporsi bola merah dalam urna adalah
\[ Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} \]

payload.source_text: \( \bs{Z} = \{Z_n: n \in \N\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \bs{X} \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs{Z} = \{Z_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \bs{X} \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
Indirect proof: If \( c = 0 \) then \( Z_n = a / (a + b) \) for \( n \in \N \) so \( \bs Z \) is a constant martingale. If \( c \in \N_+ \) then \( \bs Z \) is equivalent to the beta-Bernoulli process with parameters \( a / c \) and \( b / c \). Moreover, 
		\[ Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} = \frac{a / c + Y_n}{a / c + b / c + n}, \quad n \in \N \]
		So \( \bs Z \) is a martingale by .
payload.target_text:
Bukti tidak langsung: Jika \( c = 0 \), maka \( Z_n = a / (a + b) \) untuk \( n \in \N \), sehingga \( \bs Z \) merupakan martingal konstan. Jika \( c \in \N_+ \), maka \( \bs Z \) ekuivalen dengan proses beta-Bernoulli berparameter \( a / c \) dan \( b / c \). Lebih lanjut, 
		\[ Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} = \frac{a / c + Y_n}{a / c + b / c + n}, \quad n \in \N \]
		Jadi, \( \bs Z \) merupakan martingal berdasarkan .

payload.source_text:
Direct Proof: Trivially, \( 0 \le Z_n \le 1 \) so \( \E(Z_n) \lt \infty \) for \( n \in \N \). Let \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \). For \( n \in \N \),
		\[\E\left(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left[\frac{a + c Y_{n+1}}{a + b + c(n + 1)} \biggm| \mathscr{F}_n\right] = \frac{\E\left[a + c \left(Y_n + X_{n+1}\right) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right]}{a + b + c(n + 1)} = \frac{a + c Y_n + c \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right)}{a + b + c n + c} \]
		since \( Y_n \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_n \). But the probability of selecting a red ball on draw \( n + 1 \), given the history of the process up to time \( n \), is simply the proportion of red balls in the urn at time \( n \). That is,
		\[ \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \P\left(X_{n+1} = 1 \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} \]
		Substituting and simplifying gives \( \E\left(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = Z_n \).
payload.target_text:
Bukti langsung: Jelas bahwa \( 0 \le Z_n \le 1 \), sehingga \( \E(Z_n) \lt \infty \) untuk \( n \in \N \). Tetapkan \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \). Untuk \( n \in \N \),
		\[\E\left(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \E\left[\frac{a + c Y_{n+1}}{a + b + c(n + 1)} \biggm| \mathscr{F}_n\right] = \frac{\E\left[a + c \left(Y_n + X_{n+1}\right) \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right]}{a + b + c(n + 1)} = \frac{a + c Y_n + c \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right)}{a + b + c n + c} \]
		karena \( Y_n \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_n \). Namun, probabilitas terpilihnya bola merah pada pengambilan \( n + 1 \), jika diketahui riwayat proses hingga waktu \( n \), sama dengan proporsi bola merah dalam urna pada waktu \( n \). Artinya,
		\[ \E\left(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = \P\left(X_{n+1} = 1 \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = Z_n = \frac{a + c Y_n}{a + b + c n} \]
		Dengan menyubstitusikan dan menyederhanakan, diperoleh \( \E\left(Z_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n\right) = Z_n \).

payload.source_text: Processes with Independent Increments.
payload.target_text: Proses dengan Inkremen Independen.

payload.source_text: Our first example above concerned the partial sum process in \( \bs{X} \) associated with a sequence of independent random variables \( \bs{V} \). Such processes are the only ones in discrete time that have independent increments . That is, for \( m, \, n \in \N \) with \( m \le n \), \( X_n - X_m \) is independent of \( (X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_m) \). The random walk process in has the additional property of stationary increments . That is, the distribution of \( X_n - X_m \) is the same as the distribution of \( X_{n-m} - X_0 \) for \( m, \, n \in \N \) with \( m \le n \). Let's consider processes in discrete or continuous time with these properties. Thus, suppose that \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) satisfying the basic assumptions in above relative to the filtration \( \mathfrak{F} = \left\{\mathscr{F}_s: s \in T\right\} \). Here are the two definitions.
payload.target_text: Contoh pertama di atas membahas proses jumlah parsial \( \bs{X} \) pada yang terkait dengan barisan peubah acak independen \( \bs{V} \). Proses semacam itu adalah satu-satunya proses dalam waktu diskret yang memiliki inkremen independen . Artinya, untuk \( m, \, n \in \N \) dengan \( m \le n \), \( X_n - X_m \) independen dari \( (X_0, X_1, \ldots, X_m) \). Gerak acak pada memiliki sifat tambahan berupa inkremen stasioner . Artinya, distribusi \( X_n - X_m \) sama dengan distribusi \( X_{n-m} - X_0 \) untuk \( m, \, n \in \N \) dengan \( m \le n \). Mari kita tinjau proses dalam waktu diskret atau kontinu yang memiliki sifat-sifat ini. Jadi, misalkan \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) memenuhi asumsi dasar pada di atas relatif terhadap filtrasi \( \mathfrak{F} = \left\{\mathscr{F}_s: s \in T\right\} \). Berikut kedua definisinya.

payload.source_text: The process \( \bs X \) has
payload.target_text: Proses \( \bs X \) memiliki

payload.source_text: Independent increments if \( X_t - X_s \) is independent of \( \mathscr{F}_s \) for all \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \).
payload.target_text: Inkremen independen jika \( X_t - X_s \) independen dari \( \mathscr{F}_s \) untuk semua \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \).

payload.source_text: Stationary increments if \( X_t - X_s \) has the same distribution as \( X_{t-s} - X_0 \) for all \( s, \, t \in T \).
payload.target_text: Inkremen stasioner jika \( X_t - X_s \) memiliki distribusi yang sama dengan \( X_{t-s} - X_0 \) untuk semua \( s, \, t \in T \).

payload.source_text: Processes with stationary and independent increments were studied in the chapter on Markov processes . In continuous time (with the continuity assumptions we have imposed), such a process is known as a Lévy process , named for Paul Lévy , and also as a continuous-time random walk . For a process with independent increments (not necessarily stationary), the connection with martingales depends on the mean function \( m \) given by \( m(t) = \E(X_t) \) for \( t \in T \).
payload.target_text: Proses dengan inkremen stasioner dan independen telah dipelajari dalam bab tentang proses Markov . Dalam waktu kontinu (dengan asumsi kekontinuan yang telah kita tetapkan), proses semacam itu dikenal sebagai proses Lévy , yang dinamai menurut Paul Lévy , dan juga sebagai gerak acak waktu kontinu . Untuk proses dengan inkremen independen (yang tidak harus stasioner), hubungannya dengan martingal bergantung pada fungsi rata-rata \( m \) yang diberikan oleh \( m(t) = \E(X_t) \) untuk \( t \in T \).

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) has independent increments.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) memiliki inkremen independen.

payload.source_text: If \( m \) is increasing then \( \bs{X} \) is a sub-martingale.
payload.target_text: Jika \( m \) menaik, maka \( \bs{X} \) merupakan submartingal.

payload.source_text: If \( m \) is decreasing then \( \bs X \) is a super-martingale.
payload.target_text: Jika \( m \) menurun, maka \( \bs X \) merupakan supermartingal.

payload.source_text: If \( m \) is constant then \( \bs X \) is a martingale
payload.target_text: Jika \( m \) konstan, maka \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
The proof is just like the one above for partial sum processes. Suppose that \( s, \, t \in [0, \infty) \) with \( s \lt t \). Then
		\[ E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = \E\left[X_s + (X_t - X_s) \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right] = \E\left(X_s \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) + \E\left(X_t - X_s \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right)\]
		But \( X_s \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_s \) and \( X_t - X_s \) is independent of \( \mathscr{F}_s \) So
		\[ \E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = X_s + \E(X_t - X_s) = X_s + m(t) - m(s) \]
payload.target_text:
Buktinya sama seperti bukti untuk proses jumlah parsial di atas. Misalkan \( s, \, t \in [0, \infty) \) dengan \( s \lt t \). Maka
		\[ E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = \E\left[X_s + (X_t - X_s) \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right] = \E\left(X_s \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) + \E\left(X_t - X_s \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right)\]
		Namun, \( X_s \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_s \) dan \( X_t - X_s \) independen dari \( \mathscr{F}_s \). Jadi,
		\[ \E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = X_s + \E(X_t - X_s) = X_s + m(t) - m(s) \]

payload.source_text: Compare this result with the corresponding result for the partial sum process in . Suppose now that \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) is a stochastic process as above, with mean function \( m \), and let \( Y_t = X_t - m(t) \) for \( t \in [0, \infty) \). The process \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) is sometimes called the compensated process associated with \( \bs{X} \) and has mean function 0. If \( \bs{X} \) has independent increments, then clearly so does \( \bs{Y} \). Hence the following result is a trivial corollary to our previous theorem.
payload.target_text: Bandingkan hasil ini dengan hasil yang bersesuaian untuk proses jumlah parsial pada . Sekarang misalkan \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) adalah proses stokastik seperti di atas dengan fungsi rata-rata \( m \), dan tetapkan \( Y_t = X_t - m(t) \) untuk \( t \in [0, \infty) \). Proses \( \bs{Y} = \{Y_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) kadang-kadang disebut proses terkompensasi yang terkait dengan \( \bs{X} \), dan memiliki fungsi rata-rata 0. Jika \( \bs{X} \) memiliki inkremen independen, jelas bahwa \( \bs{Y} \) juga demikian. Karena itu, hasil berikut merupakan akibat langsung dari teorema sebelumnya.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( \bs{X} \) has independent increments. The compensated process \( \bs{Y} \) is a martingale.
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( \bs{X} \) memiliki inkremen independen. Proses terkompensasi \( \bs{Y} \) merupakan martingal.

payload.source_text: Next we give the second moment martingale for a process with independent increments, generalizing the second moment martingale for a partial sum process in .
payload.target_text: Selanjutnya, kita memberikan martingal momen kedua untuk proses dengan inkremen independen, yang menggeneralisasi martingal momen kedua bagi proses jumlah parsial pada .

payload.source_text:
Suppose that \( \bs X = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) has independent increments with constant mean function and and with \( \var(X_t) \lt \infty \) for \( t \in T \). Then \( \bs Y = \{Y_t: t \in T\} \) is a martingale where
	\[ Y_t = X_t^2 - \var(X_t), \quad t \in T \]
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( \bs X = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) memiliki inkremen independen dengan fungsi rata-rata konstan dan dengan \( \var(X_t) \lt \infty \) untuk \( t \in T \). Maka \( \bs Y = \{Y_t: t \in T\} \) merupakan martingal dengan
	\[ Y_t = X_t^2 - \var(X_t), \quad t \in T \]

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
The proof is essentially the same as for the partial sum process in discrete time. Suppose that \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \lt t \). Note that \( \E(Y_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = \E(X_t^2 \mid \mathscr{F}_s) - \var(X_t) \). Next,
		\[ X_t^2 = [(X_t - X_s) + X_s]^2 = (X_t - X_s)^2 + 2 (X_t - X_s) X_s + X_s^2 \]
		But \( X_t - X_s \) is independent of \( \mathscr{F}_s \), \( X_s \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_s \), and \( E(X_t - X_s) = 0 \) so
		\[ \E(X_t^2 \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = \E[(X_t - X_s)^2] + 2 X_s \E(X_t - X_s) + X_s^2 = \E[(X_t - X_s)^2] + X_s^2 \]
		But also by independence and since \( X_t - X_s \) has mean 0,

		\[ \E(Y_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = X_s^2 - \var(X_s) = Y_s \]

In discrete time, as we have mentioned several times, all of these results reduce to the earlier results for partial sum processes and random walks . The standard (homogeneous) Poisson counting process \( \bs N = \{N_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) with constant rate \( r \in (0, \infty) \) has stationary, independent increments and mean function given by \( m(t) = r t \) for \( t \in [0, \infty) \). More generally, suppose that \( r: [0, \infty) \to (0, \infty) \) is piecewise continuous (and non-constant). The non-homogeneous Poisson counting process \( \bs N = \{N_t: t \in [0, \infty)\} \) with rate function \( r \) has independent increments and mean function given by
\[ m(t) = \int_0^t r(s) \, ds, \quad t \in [0, \infty) \]
The increment \( N_t - N_s \) has the Poisson distribution with parameter \( m(t) - m(s) \) for \( s, \, t \in [0, \infty) \) with \( s \lt t \), so the process does not have stationary increments. payload.source_text: Branching Processes
payload.target_text: Proses Percabangan

payload.source_text: In the simplest model of a branching process , we have a system of particles each of which can die out or split into new particles of the same type. The fundamental assumption is that the particles act independently, each with the same offspring distribution on \( \N \). We will let \( f \) denote the (discrete) probability density function of the number of offspring of a particle, \( m \) the mean of the distribution, and \( \phi \) the probability generating function of the distribution. Thus, if \( U \) is the number of children of a particle, then \( f(n) = \P(U = n) \) for \( n \in \N \), \( m = \E(U) \), and \( \phi(t) = \E\left(t^U\right) \) defined at least for \( t \in (-1, 1] \).
payload.target_text: Dalam model paling sederhana dari suatu proses percabangan , kita memiliki sistem partikel yang masing-masing dapat punah atau membelah menjadi partikel-partikel baru dengan jenis yang sama. Asumsi dasarnya adalah bahwa partikel-partikel tersebut bertindak secara independen, masing-masing dengan distribusi keturunan yang sama pada \( \N \). Kita akan menggunakan \( f \) untuk menyatakan fungsi kepadatan probabilitas (diskret) dari banyaknya keturunan sebuah partikel, \( m \) untuk rata-rata distribusi tersebut, dan \( \phi \) untuk fungsi pembangkit probabilitas distribusi tersebut. Jadi, jika \( U \) adalah banyaknya anak sebuah partikel, maka \( f(n) = \P(U = n) \) untuk \( n \in \N \), \( m = \E(U) \), dan \( \phi(t) = \E\left(t^U\right) \) didefinisikan setidaknya untuk \( t \in (-1, 1] \).

payload.source_text:
Our interest is in generational time rather than absolute time : the original particles are in generation 0, and recursively, the children a particle in generation \( n \) belong to generation \( n + 1 \). Thus, the stochastic process of interest is \( \bs{X} = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) where \( X_n \) is the number of particles in the \( n \)th generation for \( n \in \N \). The process \( \bs{X} \) is a Markov chain and was studied in the section on discrete-time branching chains . In particular, one of the fundamental problems is to compute the probability \( q \) of extinction starting with a single particle:
\[ q = \P(X_n = 0 \text{ for some } n \in \N \mid X_0 = 1) \]
Then, since the particles act independently, the probability of extinction starting with \( x \in \N \) particles is simply \( q^x \). We will assume that \( f(0) \gt 0 \) and \( f(0) + f(1) \lt 1 \). This is the interesting case, since it means that a particle has a positive probability of dying without children and a positive probability of producing more than 1 child.  The fundamental result, you may recall, is that \( q \) is the smallest fixed point of \( \phi \) (so that \( \phi(q) = q \)) in the interval \( [0, 1] \). Here are two martingales associated with the branching process:
payload.target_text:

Jadi, proses stokastik yang kita kaji adalah \( \bs{X} = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \), dengan \( X_n \) merupakan banyaknya partikel pada generasi ke-\( n \) untuk \( n \in \N \). Proses \( \bs{X} \) merupakan rantai Markov dan telah dipelajari dalam bagian tentang rantai percabangan waktu diskret . Secara khusus, salah satu masalah dasarnya adalah menghitung probabilitas kepunahan \( q \) jika dimulai dengan satu partikel:
\[ q = \P(X_n = 0 \text{ for some } n \in \N \mid X_0 = 1) \]
Karena partikel-partikel tersebut bertindak secara independen, probabilitas kepunahan jika dimulai dengan \( x \in \N \) partikel adalah \( q^x \). Kita akan mengandaikan bahwa \( f(0) \gt 0 \) dan \( f(0) + f(1) \lt 1 \). Inilah kasus yang menarik, sebab sebuah partikel memiliki probabilitas positif untuk mati tanpa anak dan probabilitas positif untuk menghasilkan lebih dari 1 anak. Ingat bahwa hasil dasarnya menyatakan bahwa \( q \) adalah titik tetap terkecil dari \( \phi \) (sehingga \( \phi(q) = q \)) dalam interval \( [0, 1] \). payload.source_text: Doob's Martingale
payload.target_text: Martingal Doob

payload.source_text: Our next example is one of the simplest, but most important. Indeed, as we will see later in the section on convergence , this type of martingale is almost universal in the sense that every uniformly integrable martingale is of this type. The process is constructed by conditioning a fixed random variable on the \( \sigma \)-algebras in a given filtration, and thus accumulating information about the random variable.
payload.target_text: Contoh berikutnya termasuk salah satu yang paling sederhana, tetapi juga paling penting. Seperti yang akan kita lihat kemudian dalam bagian tentang kekonvergenan , jenis martingal ini hampir universal dalam arti bahwa setiap martingal yang terintegralkan seragam termasuk jenis ini. Proses tersebut dikonstruksi dengan mengondisikan suatu peubah acak tetap pada aljabar-\( \sigma \) dalam filtrasi tertentu, sehingga mengakumulasi informasi mengenai peubah acak tersebut.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \) is a filtration on the probability space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \), and that \( X \) is a real-valued random variable with \( \E\left(\left|X\right|\right) \lt \infty \). Define \( X_t = \E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t\right) \) for \( t \in T \). Then \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak{F} \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \) adalah filtrasi pada ruang probabilitas \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \), dan \( X \) adalah peubah acak bernilai riil dengan \( \E\left(\left|X\right|\right) \lt \infty \). Definisikan \( X_t = \E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t\right) \) untuk \( t \in T \). Maka \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak{F} \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
For \( t \in T \), recall that \( |X_t| = |\E(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t)| \le \E(|X| \mid \mathscr{F}_t) \). Taking expected values gives \( \E(|X_t|) \le \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). Suppose that \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \lt t \). Using the tower property of conditional expected value,
		\[ \E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = \E\left[\E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t\right) \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right] = \E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = X_s \]
payload.target_text:
Untuk \( t \in T \), ingat bahwa \( |X_t| = |\E(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t)| \le \E(|X| \mid \mathscr{F}_t) \). Dengan mengambil nilai harapan, diperoleh \( \E(|X_t|) \le \E(|X|) \lt \infty \). Misalkan \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \lt t \). Dengan menggunakan sifat menara nilai harapan bersyarat,
		\[ \E\left(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = \E\left[\E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_t\right) \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right] = \E\left(X \mid \mathscr{F}_s\right) = X_s \]

payload.source_text: The martingale in the last theorem is known as Doob's martingale and is named for Joseph Doob who did much of the pioneering work on martingales. It's also known as the Lévy martingale , named for Paul Lévy .
payload.target_text: Martingal dalam teorema terakhir dikenal sebagai martingal Doob dan dinamai menurut Joseph Doob , yang banyak melakukan pekerjaan perintis tentang martingal. Martingal ini juga dikenal sebagai martingal Lévy , yang dinamai menurut Paul Lévy .

payload.source_text:
Doob's martingale arises naturally in the statistical context of Bayesian estimation . Suppose that \( \bs X = (X_1, X_2, \ldots) \) is a sequence of independent random variables whose common distribution depends on an unknown real-valued parameter \( \theta \), with values in a parameter space \( A \subseteq \R \). For each \( n \in \N_+ \), let \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \) so that \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N_+\} \) is the natural filtration associated with \( \bs X \). In Bayesian estimation, we model the unknown parameter \( \theta \) with a random variable \( \Theta \) taking values in \( A \) and having a specified prior distribution . The Bayesian estimator of \( \theta \) based on the sample \( \bs{X}_n = (X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n) \) is 
\[ U_n = \E(\Theta \mid \mathscr{F}_n), \quad n \in \N_+ \]
So it follows that the sequence of Bayesian estimators \( \bs U = (U_n: n \in \N_+) \) is a Doob martingale. The estimation referred to in the discussion of the beta-Bernoulli process above is a special case.
payload.target_text:
Martingal Doob muncul secara alami dalam konteks statistika berupa pendugaan Bayes . Misalkan \( \bs X = (X_1, X_2, \ldots) \) adalah barisan peubah acak independen dengan distribusi yang sama, yang bergantung pada parameter bernilai riil \( \theta \) yang tidak diketahui dan bernilai dalam ruang parameter \( A \subseteq \R \). Untuk setiap \( n \in \N_+ \), tetapkan \( \mathscr{F}_n = \sigma\{X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n\} \), sehingga \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N_+\} \) merupakan filtrasi alami yang terkait dengan \( \bs X \). Dalam pendugaan Bayes, kita memodelkan parameter \( \theta \) yang tidak diketahui dengan peubah acak \( \Theta \) yang bernilai di \( A \) dan memiliki distribusi prior tertentu. Penduga Bayes bagi \( \theta \) berdasarkan sampel \( \bs{X}_n = (X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n) \) adalah 
\[ U_n = \E(\Theta \mid \mathscr{F}_n), \quad n \in \N_+ \]
Karena itu, barisan penduga Bayes \( \bs U = (U_n: n \in \N_+) \) merupakan martingal Doob. Pendugaan yang disebutkan dalam pembahasan proses beta-Bernoulli di atas merupakan kasus khusus.

payload.source_text: Density Functions
payload.target_text: Fungsi Kepadatan

payload.source_text: For this example, you may need to review the sections on general measures and density functions . We start with our probability space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \) and filtration \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \) in discrete time. Suppose now that \( \mu \) is a finite measure on the sample space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}) \). For each \( n \in \N \), the restriction of \( \mu \) to \( \mathscr{F}_n \) is a measure on the measurable space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}_n) \), and similarly the restriction of \( \P \) to \(\mathscr{F}_n\) is a probability measure on \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}_n) \). To save notation and terminology, we will refer to these as \( \mu \) and \( \P \) on \(\mathscr{F}_n\) , respectively. Suppose now that \( \mu \) is absolutely continuous with respect to \( \P \) on \( \mathscr{F}_n \) for each \( n \in \N \). Recall that this means that if \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \) and \( \P(A) = 0 \) then \( \mu(B) = 0 \) for every \( B \in \mathscr{F}_n \) with \( B \subseteq A \). By the Radon-Nikodym theorem , \( \mu \)  has a density function \( X_n: \Omega \to \R \) with respect to \( \P \) on \(\mathscr{F}_n\) for each \( n \in \N_+ \). The density function of a measure with respect to a positive measure is known as a Radon-Nikodym derivative . The theorem and the derivative are named for Johann Radon and Otto Nikodym . Here is our main result.
payload.target_text: Untuk contoh ini, Anda mungkin perlu meninjau kembali bagian tentang ukuran umum dan fungsi kepadatan . Kita mulai dengan ruang probabilitas \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \) dan filtrasi \( \mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \) dalam waktu diskret. Sekarang misalkan \( \mu \) adalah ukuran hingga pada ruang sampel \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}) \). Untuk setiap \( n \in \N \), pembatasan \( \mu \) pada \( \mathscr{F}_n \) merupakan ukuran pada ruang terukur \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}_n) \); demikian pula, pembatasan \( \P \) pada \(\mathscr{F}_n\) merupakan ukuran probabilitas pada \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}_n) \). Untuk menyederhanakan notasi dan istilah, kita akan menyebut keduanya masing-masing sebagai \( \mu \) dan \( \P \) pada \(\mathscr{F}_n\) . Sekarang misalkan \( \mu \) kontinu mutlak terhadap \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr{F}_n \) untuk setiap \( n \in \N \). Ingat bahwa ini berarti bahwa jika \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \) dan \( \P(A) = 0 \), maka \( \mu(B) = 0 \) untuk setiap \( B \in \mathscr{F}_n \) dengan \( B \subseteq A \). Berdasarkan teorema Radon-Nikodym , \( \mu \) memiliki fungsi kepadatan \( X_n: \Omega \to \R \) terhadap \( \P \) pada \(\mathscr{F}_n\) untuk setiap \( n \in \N_+ \). Fungsi kepadatan suatu ukuran terhadap ukuran positif dikenal sebagai turunan Radon-Nikodym . Teorema dan turunan tersebut dinamai menurut Johann Radon dan Otto Nikodym . Berikut hasil utamanya.

payload.source_text: \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs X = \{X_n: n \in \N\} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text:
Let \( n \in \N \). By definition, \( X_n \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_n \). Also, \( \E(|X_n|) = \|\mu\|\) (the total variation of \( \mu \)) for each \( n \in \N \). Since \( \mu \) is a finite measure, \( \|\mu\| \lt \infty \). By definition,
		\[ \mu(A) = \int_A X_n d \P = \E(X_n; A), \quad A \in \mathscr{F}_n \]
		On the other hand, if \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \) then \( A \in \mathscr{F}_{n+1} \) and so \( \mu(A) = \E(X_{n+1}; A) \). So to summarize, \( X_n \) is \( \mathscr{F}_n \)-measurable and \( \E(X_{n+1}; A) = \E(X_n ; A) \) for all \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \). By definition, this means that \( \E(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = X_n \), and so \( \bs X \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \).
payload.target_text:
Misalkan \( n \in \N \). Berdasarkan definisi, \( X_n \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_n \). Selain itu, \( \E(|X_n|) = \|\mu\|\) (variasi total \( \mu \)) untuk setiap \( n \in \N \). Karena \( \mu \) adalah ukuran hingga, \( \|\mu\| \lt \infty \). Berdasarkan definisi,
		\[ \mu(A) = \int_A X_n d \P = \E(X_n; A), \quad A \in \mathscr{F}_n \]
		Di sisi lain, jika \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \), maka \( A \in \mathscr{F}_{n+1} \), sehingga \( \mu(A) = \E(X_{n+1}; A) \). Ringkasnya, \( X_n \) bersifat \( \mathscr{F}_n \)-terukur dan \( \E(X_{n+1}; A) = \E(X_n ; A) \) untuk semua \( A \in \mathscr{F}_n \). Berdasarkan definisi, ini berarti bahwa \( \E(X_{n+1} \mid \mathscr{F}_n) = X_n \), sehingga \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \).

payload.source_text: Note that \( \mu \) may not be absolutely continuous with respect to \( \P \) on \( \mathscr{F} \) or even on \( \mathscr{F}_\infty = \sigma \left(\bigcup_{n=0}^\infty \mathscr{F}_n\right) \). On the other hand, if \( \mu \) is absolutely continuous with respect to \( \P \) on \( \mathscr{F}_\infty \) then \( \mu \) has a density function \( X \) with respect to \( \P \) on \( \mathscr{F}_\infty \). So a natural question in this case is the relationship between the martingale \( \bs X \) and the random variable \( X \). You may have already guessed the answer, but at any rate it will be given in the section on convergence .
payload.target_text: Perhatikan bahwa \( \mu \) mungkin tidak kontinu mutlak terhadap \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr{F} \), bahkan mungkin tidak pada \( \mathscr{F}_\infty = \sigma \left(\bigcup_{n=0}^\infty \mathscr{F}_n\right) \). Di sisi lain, jika \( \mu \) memang kontinu mutlak terhadap \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr{F}_\infty \), maka \( \mu \) memiliki fungsi kepadatan \( X \) terhadap \( \P \) pada \( \mathscr{F}_\infty \). Jadi, pertanyaan alami dalam kasus ini adalah hubungan antara martingal \( \bs X \) dan peubah acak \( X \). Anda mungkin sudah dapat menebak jawabannya, tetapi bagaimanapun juga jawabannya akan diberikan dalam bagian tentang kekonvergenan .

payload.source_text: Preliminaries
payload.target_text: Pendahuluan

payload.source_text: As in the introduction , we start with a stochastic process \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) on an underlying probability space \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \), having state space \( \R \), and where the index set \( T \) (representing time) is either \( \N \) (discrete time) or \( [0, \infty) \) (continuous time). Next, we have a filtration \(\mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \), and we assume that \( \bs{X} \) is adapted to \( \mathfrak{F} \). So \( \mathfrak{F} \) is an increasing family of sub \( \sigma \)-algebras of \( \mathscr{F} \) and \( X_t \) is measurable with respect to \( \mathscr{F}_t \) for \( t \in T \). We think of \( \mathscr{F}_t \) as the collection of events up to time \( t \in T \). We assume that \( \E\left(\left|X_t\right|\right) \lt \infty \), so that the mean of \( X_t \) exists as a real number, for each \( t \in T \). Finally, in continuous time where \( T = [0, \infty) \), we make the standard assumptions that \( \bs X \) is right continuous and has left limits, and that the filtration \( \mathfrak F \) is right continuous and complete. Please recall the following from the introduction:
payload.target_text: Seperti pada pendahuluan , kita mulai dengan suatu proses stokastik \( \bs{X} = \{X_t: t \in T\} \) pada ruang probabilitas yang mendasarinya \( (\Omega, \mathscr{F}, \P) \), dengan ruang keadaan \( \R \), dan dengan himpunan indeks \( T \) (yang menyatakan waktu) berupa \( \N \) (waktu diskret) atau \( [0, \infty) \) (waktu kontinu). Selanjutnya, kita memiliki suatu filtrasi \(\mathfrak{F} = \{\mathscr{F}_t: t \in T\} \), dan kita mengandaikan bahwa \( \bs{X} \) teradaptasi terhadap \( \mathfrak{F} \). Jadi, \( \mathfrak{F} \) adalah keluarga menaik subaljabar-\( \sigma \) dari \( \mathscr{F} \), dan \( X_t \) terukur terhadap \( \mathscr{F}_t \) untuk \( t \in T \). Kita memandang \( \mathscr{F}_t \) sebagai koleksi kejadian hingga waktu \( t \in T \). Kita mengandaikan bahwa \( \E\left(\left|X_t\right|\right) \lt \infty \), sehingga rata-rata \( X_t \) ada sebagai bilangan riil untuk setiap \( t \in T \). Terakhir, dalam waktu kontinu ketika \( T = [0, \infty) \), kita menggunakan asumsi standar bahwa \( \bs X \) kontinu kanan dan memiliki limit kiri, serta bahwa filtrasi \( \mathfrak F \) kontinu kanan dan lengkap. Ingat kembali hal berikut dari pendahuluan:

payload.source_text: Definitions
payload.target_text: Definisi

payload.source_text: \( \bs X \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) if \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = X_s \) for all \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \) jika \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) = X_s \) untuk semua \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \).

payload.source_text: \( \bs X \) is a sub-martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) if \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \ge X_s \) for all \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs X \) merupakan submartingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \) jika \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \ge X_s \) untuk semua \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \).

payload.source_text: \( \bs X \) is a super-martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) if \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \le X_s \) for all \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \).
payload.target_text: \( \bs X \) merupakan supermartingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \) jika \( \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \le X_s \) untuk semua \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \).

payload.source_text: Our goal in this section is to give a number of basic properties of martingales and to give ways of constructing martingales from other types of processes. The deeper, fundamental theorems will be studied in the following sections.
payload.target_text: Tujuan kita dalam bagian ini adalah menyajikan sejumlah sifat dasar martingal dan berbagai cara mengonstruksi martingal dari jenis proses lain. Teorema-teorema mendasar yang lebih dalam akan dipelajari dalam bagian-bagian berikutnya.

payload.source_text: Basic Properties
payload.target_text: Sifat Dasar

payload.source_text: Our first result is that the martingale property is preserved under a coarser filtration.
payload.target_text: Hasil pertama kita menyatakan bahwa sifat martingal dipertahankan apabila filtrasinya dibuat lebih kasar.

payload.source_text: Suppose that the process \( \bs X \) and the filtration \( \mathfrak F \) satisfy the basic assumptions above and that \( \mathfrak G \) is a filtration coarser than \( \mathfrak F \) so that \( \mathscr{G}_t \subseteq \mathscr{F}_t \) for \( t \in T \). If \( \bs X \) is a martingale (sub-martingale, super-martingale) with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) and \( \bs X \) is adapted to \( \mathfrak G \) then \( \bs X \) is a martingale (sub-martingale, super-martingale) with respect to \( \mathfrak G \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan proses \( \bs X \) dan filtrasi \( \mathfrak F \) memenuhi asumsi dasar di atas, dan \( \mathfrak G \) merupakan filtrasi yang lebih kasar daripada \( \mathfrak F \), sehingga \( \mathscr{G}_t \subseteq \mathscr{F}_t \) untuk \( t \in T \). Jika \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal (submartingal, supermartingal) terhadap \( \mathfrak F \) dan \( \bs X \) teradaptasi terhadap \( \mathfrak G \), maka \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal (submartingal, supermartingal) terhadap \( \mathfrak G \).

payload.source_text: Details:
payload.target_text: Rincian:

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \). The proof uses the tower and increasing properties of conditional expected value, and the fact that \( \bs X \) is adapted to \( \mathfrak G \)
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \). Bukti ini menggunakan sifat menara dan sifat kemonotonan nilai harapan bersyarat, serta fakta bahwa \( \bs X \) teradaptasi terhadap \( \mathfrak G \).

payload.source_text:
If \( \bs X \) is a martingale with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) then
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] = \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]
payload.target_text:
Jika \( \bs X \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \), maka
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] = \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]

payload.source_text:
If \( \bs X \) is a sub-martinagle with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) then 
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] \ge \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]
payload.target_text:
Jika \( \bs X \) merupakan submartingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \), maka 
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] \ge \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]

payload.source_text:
If \( \bs X \) is a super-martinagle with respect to \( \mathfrak F \) then 
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] \le \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]
payload.target_text:
Jika \( \bs X \) merupakan supermartingal terhadap \( \mathfrak F \), maka 
			\[ \E(X_t \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = \E\left[\E(X_t \mid \mathscr{F}_s) \mid \mathscr{G}_s\right] \le \E(X_s \mid \mathscr{G}_s) = X_s \]

payload.source_text: In particular, if \( \bs{X} \) is a martingale (sub-martingale, super-martingale) with respect to some filtration, then it is a martingale (sub-martingale, super-martingale) with respect to its own natural filtration.
payload.target_text: Khususnya, jika \( \bs{X} \) merupakan martingal (submartingal, supermartingal) terhadap suatu filtrasi, maka proses tersebut merupakan martingal (submartingal, supermartingal) terhadap filtrasi alaminya sendiri.

payload.source_text: The relations that define martingales, sub-martingales, and super-martingales hold for the ordinary (unconditional) expected values. We had this result in the last section, but it's worth repeating.
payload.target_text: Relasi yang mendefinisikan martingal, submartingal, dan supermartingal juga berlaku untuk nilai harapan biasa (tak bersyarat). Hasil ini telah kita peroleh dalam bagian sebelumnya, tetapi layak diulang.

payload.source_text: Suppose that \( s, \, t \in T \) with \( s \le t \).
payload.target_text: Misalkan \( s, \, t \in T \) dengan \( s \le t \).

payload.source_text: If \( \bs{X} \) is a martingale with respect to \( \frak{F} \) then \( \E(X_s) = \E(X_t) \).
payload.target_text: Jika \( \bs{X} \) merupakan martingal terhadap \( \frak{F} \), maka \( \E(X_s) = \E(X_t) \).

payload.source_text: If \( \bs{X} \) is a sub-martingale with respect to \( \frak{F} \) then \( \E(X_s) \le \E(X_t) \).

payload.source_text: Our next discussion, in discrete time, shows how to build a new martingale from an existing martingale and an predictable process. This construction turns out to be very useful, and has an interesting gambling interpretation. To review the definition, recall that \( \{Y_n: n \in \N_+\} \) is predictable relative to the filtration \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \) if \( Y_n\) is measurable with respect to \(\mathscr{F}_{n-1} \) for \( n \in \N_+ \). Think of \( Y_n \) as the bet that a gambler makes on game \( n \in \N_+ \). The gambler can base the bet on all of the information she has at that point, including the outcomes of the previous \( n - 1 \) games. That is, she can base the bet on the information encoded in \( \mathscr{F}_{n-1} \).
payload.target_text: Pembahasan berikutnya, dalam waktu diskret, menunjukkan cara membangun martingal baru dari martingal yang sudah ada dan suatu proses terprediksi. Konstruksi ini ternyata sangat berguna dan memiliki interpretasi perjudian yang menarik. Untuk meninjau definisinya, ingat bahwa \( \{Y_n: n \in \N_+\} \) bersifat terprediksi terhadap filtrasi \( \mathfrak F = \{\mathscr{F}_n: n \in \N\} \) jika \( Y_n\) terukur terhadap \(\mathscr{F}_{n-1} \) untuk \( n \in \N_+ \). Pandang \( Y_n \) sebagai taruhan yang dipasang penjudi pada permainan \( n \in \N_+ \). Penjudi dapat mendasarkan taruhan tersebut pada semua informasi yang dimilikinya saat itu, termasuk hasil dari \( n - 1 \) permainan sebelumnya. Artinya, ia dapat mendasarkan taruhan itu pada informasi yang dikodekan dalam \( \mathscr{F}_{n-1} \).
